notes.title: Without Within 3 pre-release sale!
notes.notes:
[img=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/30077a12ea62784972cd780b0fcfa6d466c99bde.jpg][/img]

Hi everyone :vintypretty:! Without Within 3 comes out in three days, and to prep for that, we have a sale going on:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=InvertMouse][/url]

[img=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/e5dcb54243b2ececd800014930b3e05d84e14c27.jpg][/img]

Also, we have a quick Q&A to address some WOWI 3 related items:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/676130/announcements/detail/1673527710531339085][/url]

And, of course, here is Without Within 3's store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/676130/Without_Within_3/][/url]

Thank you for your support through the past five years! Hope to see you in Vinty's third (mis)adventure this Friday :excelia:.

notes.title: Japanese translation patch released for Unhack
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/MRGDxBn.png][/img]

Hello everyone. kagerou01gata over in Japan has kindly translated Unhack into Japanese for us! The patch is available [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/rgzqlqnewqa46cp/Unhack1%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E%E5%8C%96%E3%83%91%E3%83%83%E3%83%81rev1.zip?dl=0]here[/url].

[img=http://i.imgur.com/xaTBj1n.png][/img]

Without Within 1 and 2 were both translated by paid companies, so this is the first fan translation I have received, and I am really grateful for it. We are living in such a wonderful era, where gamers are able to support one another like this.

Thank you so much ːweedyː!
